runs.issue: dylan-014: truncated quote. Stored content was "I welcome them—with open arms." but the full line, confirmed via multiple independent transcript/press sources of the 1965 KQED San Francisco press conference, is "I welcome them with open arms and my bank account also welcomes them." The dropped clause is the actual punchline of Dylan's ironic answer about people who analyze his songs -- the stored version read as a sincere answer instead of the joke it was.
runs.resolution: fixed in this run's PR; content corrected to the full line, notes updated to record the correction. dylan-005..013 all verified verbatim (Nobel banquet speech, Nobel Lecture 2017, MusiCares 2015 speech, and the same 1965 KQED press conference, all primary/authoritative sources) -- no changes needed.
